name: mcp-wagewatch
display_name: WageWatch — DOL wage and hour enforcement
description: Employer wage-theft history from the U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division enforcement dataset: back wages owed, civil penalties, employees affected, and the repeat/willful violator flag.
long_description:
Wraps the WHISARD compliance-action dataset (every concluded WHD compliance action since FY2005) served from the DOL Open Data API. Built for worker-justice nonprofits, legal-aid intake and union researchers: search an employer by name, aggregate what they were made to pay, list the largest cases in a state or industry, and pull the per-statute breakdown of one case.

Every answer states its vintage. WHD publishes concluded investigations on a lag, so these are historical enforcement records rather than an employer's present compliance state, and an empty result means no concluded published case was found — not that none exists.

Read-only: the server queries the public DOL API and sends nothing anywhere.

api_key.title: DOL Open Data API key
api_key.description: Free key from https://dataportal.dol.gov/registration. Every tool needs it: without one the server answers with an error naming this setting.

tools.name: employer_violations
tools.description: Search enforcement cases by employer name, optionally filtered to a state and a date window.

tools.name: back_wages_summary
tools.description: Aggregate back wages, employees affected, civil penalties and case count for an employer and/or state.

tools.name: violations_by_state
tools.description: Top cases in a state where a violation was found, optionally filtered by NAICS industry prefix.

tools.name: top_cases
tools.description: The largest cases by back wages nationally, in a state, in an industry, or in a date window.

tools.name: flagged_employers
tools.description: Cases carrying WHD's FLSA repeat/willful violator flag (R, W or RW).

tools.name: case_detail
tools.description: Full record for one case, including which labor statutes were cited.
